race.description: Mercure Kooindah Waters Ladies In The Lead Mdn Plate
race.comment: BUONGIORNO (3) made an encouraging debut when he gripped on late to finish third over 1500m at Hawkesbury. Has the upside to overcome the awkward draw. Leading player. GRUNGE (4) was a month between runs when he bounced back quickly to finish second over 1630m at Wyong. Strips fitter fourth-up and can play a significant role. HALEKULANI (5) battled on fairly into a midfield finish on debut at Hawkesbury earlier this month. Is sure to have come on from the race experience and looks better suited stretching to this trip. CRISPY LEAVES (11) warmed nicely late here two weeks ago when resuming and is another that should appreciate the rise in trip. Not underestimating.
